name: What should I check before deciding to convert my garage into living quarters?

mainEntity.name: What should I check before deciding to convert my garage into living quarters?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before beginning, confirm that your property can legally accommodate the loss of off-street parking. Many municipalities and homeowner associations have minimum off-street parking rules that require at least two driveway or garage spaces. You must also determine the target function: a guest bedroom, home office, rental ADU, or in-law suite. Measure your existing electrical panel to see if it has open breaker slots, locate the nearest main plumbing stack if you want a bathroom, and gather any HOA design guidelines governing exterior materials and street-facing window placement.
acceptedAnswer.description: Check local zoning and HOA parking requirements, inspect electrical panel capacity, and evaluate plumbing access if adding a bathroom or kitchenette.
